name: unigo
description: UNIGO - Plateforme web pour les etudiants etrangers au Senegal (Universite, Transport, Activites)

scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate -w server && npm run prisma:push -w server && npm run seed -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
